jobs.title: Senior Communications and Donor Stewardship Manager
jobs.reason: The candidate's academic background in International Relations and related fields aligns well with the Pew Research Center's mission and areas of study. They possess strong research, data analysis, and academic writing skills, and are multilingual. However, this role requires 10+ years of experience in strategic communications, fundraising, and donor relations, which the candidate, with only student assistant experience, does not meet. They also lack direct experience in grant proposal writing and program budgeting at the required senior level.

jobs.title: Climate Manager, China - 12 Month FTC

While the candidate possesses strong research, data analysis, policy writing, and organizational skills, the "Manager" title suggests a level of professional experience that the candidate, with only student assistant roles, has not yet attained.

jobs.title: Assistant Editor – Research Publications
jobs.reason: The candidate's academic background in International Relations and explicit interest in security studies align perfectly with RUSI's focus. However, while the candidate has strong academic writing and research skills, they lack the "proven, extensive experience of copy-editing and proofreading" and direct "project-managing publications from author handover to delivery" that are essential requirements for this role. The seniority level, requiring professional publishing experience, is a stretch for someone with only student assistant experience.

The seniority level is also far too high for someone with only student assistant experience.
